sentences.text: No: the documents do not state that a UCB may levy a higher penal charge on a retail borrower than on a corporate customer for the same breach, and they say penal charges shall be reasonable and levied in a non-discriminatory manner within a particular loan / product category.
They also say a UCB may adopt a suitable structure of penal charges, and the penal charges can be different within the same product category depending upon the amount of loan.

missing.searched: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025; searched for any rule permitting a higher penal charge for a retail borrower than for a corporate customer for the same breach
